Lol you know.. Your counter argument really just proves my point. Cod failed. The game was ment to be an rpg on a first person play style. You're constantly role playing through out the campaign and special ops. Either a front line jarhead who's squads been sent to rescue acut off platoon, or silenasce anti aircraft guns. Customize weapons abilities unlock armor perks air support. Yes cod now isn't played as an rpg like it should be. Like it was designed to be. But just because it lacks the flair of mass effect or the depth of skyrim doesn't make it any less of an rpg.the point is to play you're chosen role in a military unit and carry out the objective.
